name: Domain role synchronization
description: Automatically grants configured roles to a user, on save, based on the Domain Access domains they are affiliated with (per-domain role mapping stored as third-party settings).
project_description: Domain role synchronization is a small bridge between the Domain (Domain Access) ecosystem and Drupal's role system. An administrator associates a domain with one or more roles; whenever a user affiliated with that domain (via the field_domain_access field) is created or saved, the module adds the domain's mapped roles to that user. The mapping is stored as third-party settings on each Domain config entity and edited from a fieldset added to the Domain edit form. It is useful for wiring role-only tools (for example Menu admin per menu) into a per-domain structure by keeping a role-per-domain assignment in step with domain affiliation. In this 1.x dev branch the sync is one-directional and additive only: it grants roles from domain affiliation on user presave; it does not remove roles when an affiliation ends, and the reverse direction (adding a domain affiliation when a user gains a role) is on the roadmap and not implemented.
